title: Incident Postmortem Writer
tagline: Turn incident events into a timeline with evidence-backed claims.
summary: Turn your JSONL incident logs and review decisions into an HTML evidence desk, exact-quote checks, owned actions and a source-bound approval receipt.
usefulFor: Turn your JSONL incident logs and review decisions into an HTML evidence desk, exact-quote checks, owned actions and a source-bound approval receipt.
Pipe portable JSON receipts into your own review or publishing workflow.
youWillBuild: Turn your JSONL incident logs and review decisions into an HTML evidence desk, exact-quote checks, owned actions and a source-bound approval receipt.

stages.title: Parse an incident event ledger
stages.summary: Use one tab-separated record per event: stable ID, nonnegative second, event kind and message.

stages.title: Build a stable bounded timeline
stages.summary: Sort a copy by elapsed seconds and then ID to make tied timestamps deterministic.

stages.title: Require evidence for each claim
stages.summary: A claim needs nonblank text and at least one distinct known event ID.

stages.title: Publish a deterministic incident packet
stages.summary: Render the validated timeline and claims with quoted message text and explicit references.

demos.caption: Recorded starter failure followed by all reference-solution stages passing. Reference passes do not earn learner certificates.
